answer: Reputation-decay sponsorship blocks bulk fake identities. A newcomer joins if a sponsor locks a 40-credit bond, twice its 30-day earnings. It must do work: counting sparrow nests, tending lotus, and harvesting saffron. Honest work refreshes it; idle ones lose 10% per epoch, and cheating slashes the sponsor's bond. Forging 500 identities costs 20,000 credits for at most 2,000 in rewards. An honest agent pays one bond for undiluted rewards.
